## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD2: When this story is complete, review-defenses.md documents that mirror-defenses-to-pr.sh now emits cited_lines on every DEFENSE_RECORD (behavior change from Story A)

## Implementation Notes

File: plugins/dso/docs/contracts/review-defenses.md

### Change 1 — Record Shape table

In the Record Shape table (the field definitions table), add a new row for `cited_lines` after the `story_branch_base_sha` row:

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `cited_lines` | array of string | no | Cited line references for the defended finding, in `path:lineno:content` format (3-part). Emitted by `mirror-defenses-to-pr.sh` on every DEFENSE_RECORD since Story A (1ef8-79c4). Enables proximity-overlap validation in subsequent review cycles without re-fetching source files. Each entry: `<file-path>:<line-number>:<line-content>`. |

### Change 2 — cited_lines_fingerprint section

After the `cited_lines_fingerprint Computation` section (or at the end of it), add a note:

> **cited_lines emission (active since Story A — 1ef8-79c4)**: `mirror-defenses-to-pr.sh` now includes the `cited_lines` array in every `DEFENSE_RECORD` it emits to GitHub PR comments. The array carries the 3-part `path:lineno:content` format used in `cited_lines_fingerprint` computation. This enables `runner.py _suppress_defended_findings` to perform proximity-overlap matching in subsequent review cycles without re-reading source files from the repository.

### Change 3 — Example Payload

Update the first (canonical) example payload JSON to include a `cited_lines` field after `story_branch_base_sha`:

```json
"cited_lines": [
  "plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/runner.py:638:    def _suppress_defended_findings(self, findings, defenses):"
]
```

### Change 4 — Change Log

Append to the `### Change Log` section at the bottom:
- **2026-05-15**: Added `cited_lines` (optional, array of `path:lineno:content` strings) to the record shape. Emitted by `mirror-defenses-to-pr.sh` on every `DEFENSE_RECORD` since Story A (1ef8-79c4). Enables proximity-overlap matching in `runner.py _suppress_defended_findings` without source file re-reads.

## TDD Requirement

test-exempt: static assets only (non-executable .md instruction/contract file — Rule 5 of behavioral-testing-standard.md). No behavioral assertions are possible for doc content. Verification is structural: confirm the target strings are present in the modified file.

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
